summary: Recent discussions cover a new External Lookup Join strategy to reduce latency in stream processing, a trial of an AI‑powered code review bot for Spark PRs, and proposals to add a built‑in ADBC data source and address Istio strict mTLS communication failures. These topics reflect ongoing efforts to improve performance, tooling, and security in Spark.

highlights.text: Proposed External Lookup Join strategy for on‑demand lookups of a static side during stream processing to lower latency and boost throughput
Trial of an AI‑powered code review bot using Claude to generate inline comments with severity labels for new Spark PRs

sources.title: [DISCUSS] Automated AI code review on new Spark PRs (trial)

highlights.text: Proposal to add a built‑in ADBC data source enabling columnar Arrow reads and writes without copying data
Discussion on Istio strict mTLS mode rejecting traffic to pod IPs not backed by a Service, causing executor‑to‑executor communication failures

sources.title: [DISCUSS] SPARK-42411: Opt-in executor headless Service for Istio strict mTLS on K8s
